title: Responder: work a call and document the outcome
audience: Members who receive calls, respond, collaborate at an incident, or complete field records.
summary: Follow an incident from call discovery and dispatch through active response, field evidence, and an accurately labeled draft or review state.
prerequisites: Fictional Dept 51 training account with appropriate access. Use actual normal login after human clears the Chrome extension block; never capture credential values.
Keep existing medical standby 51002 open and parent-reserved 51006 untouched. Coordinate any new/create/close scenario with the Core numbering/run-card owner before mutation.
The currently captured standby has no protocols, linked preplan, related calls, active incident command, video feeds or Check-In tab. Populated examples require separately guarded fictional fixtures.
Field-policy-loaded Create/Edit forms, catalog-offered compatible Records definitions, and a timer-enabled call with an eligible target are prerequisites for the unrecorded branches.
Preserve Engine 51 Officer/TeamLead role 51001 assigned to Christopher Herrmann; do not alter unit roles, qualifications, global policies or seeded approvals.
No external provider reads/dispatch, GPS permissions, camera capture, attestation, account-security changes or financial operations in this browser exercise.
